# AEV Studios

> AEV Studios is a website design and AI automation studio based in Jagdalpur,
> Chhattisgarh, India, founded by Chandan Soni. We build custom websites,
> AI workflows, Growth Operating Systems and CRM infrastructure.

- Brand name: AEV Studios

- Service area: Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh, India, and remote worldwide

## Services
- Custom Web Experiences: Next.js and React websites, landing pages, technical SEO.
  Starting at INR 24,999.
- AI Workflows & Automation: autonomous workflows, API and webhook bridges,
  document and invoice AI, n8n and Make automation. Starting at INR 49,999.
- Growth Operating Systems: operational dashboards, centralized data hubs,
  automated pipelines, client portals. Starting at INR 99,999.
- CRM & Lead Infrastructure: automated lead capture, pipeline analytics,
  lead scoring, multichannel sequences.
- AI Agents: internal knowledge retrieval, instant lead qualification,
  internal request handling.
